item.title: Hip-hop pioneer, Afrika Bambaataa, dies aged 68
item.description:
📝 Bambaataa was born to Jamaican and Barbadian immigrant parents. Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, Afrika Bambaataa with the Zulu Nation crew on 10 February 1995 in New York City. Bambaataa led Universal Zulu Nation until 2016, stepping down after allegations of sexual abuse surfaced from the 1980s and 1990s.
